item.title: America and the Black Vote: AAECF forum
item.description: A nonpartisan forum marking Black History Month will examine the historical legacy and contemporary impact of the Black vote on American democracy.

item.title: Riverhead woman facing murder charge in 32-year-old cold case
item.description: A Riverhead woman is facing a murder charge in a cold case dating back to September 1993, according to Suffolk County criminal court filings.

item.title: Riverhead’s Anti-Bias Task Force chair stepping down, eyeing broader youth outreach efforts, as he mulls future run for elective office
item.description: Mark McLaughlin said is resigning from the Anti-Bias Task Force to work on community programs on a broader scale, and someday run for elective office.

item.title: Democrats give Halpin nod for re-election bid
item.description: Riverhead Democrats officially named Supervisor Jerry Halpin their candidate in the upcoming election at a committee meeting Thursday night.

item.title: Roanoke Avenue Elementary School students celebrate P.S. I Love You Day all week long
item.description: Roanoke Avenue Elementary School students delivered 400 valentines to the Westhampton Care Center Thursday as part of a P.S. I Love You Day weeklong event.

item.title: SCWA sues Riverhead Town over North Fork pipeline project
item.description: Suffolk County Water Authority sued Riverhead, seeking a court ruling that its North Fork pipeline project is exempt from local zoning.

item.title: A celebration of history and culture, and a call to overcome modern tribalism
item.description: The Riverhead school district's Black History Month program Thursday featured dance, music, history, poetry and a compelling keynote speech. Photos.

item.title: Police seek man wanted in theft at Riverhead Target
item.description: Suffolk County Crime Stoppers and Riverhead Town police are asking for the public’s help to identify a man accused of stealing about $300 worth of clothing from Target in Riverhead and fleeing on a black motorcycle.
